Let’s call this out for what it really is: a glaring indictment of how unchecked elite power and capital capture our democratic institutions, as seen in the latest developments within the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections. 

Political parties are meant to serve as vehicles for popular representation and public service, but instead, they have morphed into exclusive clubs for the wealthy. And who pays the price? It is the working class and marginalized communities, bearing the brunt of this systemic inequality. 

Make no mistake: this is a calculated, systemic disenfranchisement of ordinary people by a wealthy ruling class fiercely protecting its own interests at the expense of genuine democracy and institutional reform. Until we dismantle these entrenched power structures, the vulnerable will continue to be exploited by capital.
